status.en: 25 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 17% fewer than the week before, most of them in Tigray, Amhara and Addis Ababa.
status.nb: 25 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 17 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Tigray, Amhara og Addis Ababa.

summary.en: Ethiopian drones have struck Eritrean forces accused of backing Tigrayan rebels, while Eritrea says Ethiopian‑backed troops have crossed into its territory, prompting both sides to appeal to the UN for deterrence or intervention. The fighting now spans Tigray, Amhara and the border area, with Ethiopia warning Eritrea it will defend itself after alleged troop incursions. Eritrea and Ethiopia are accusing each other of provoking war as Tigray rebels retreat. The UN chief expressed grave concern about renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia. The UCDP recorded 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Etiopiske droner har angrepet eritreiske styrker som er anklaget for å støtte tigrayanske opprørere, mens Eritrea sier at etiopisk‑støttede tropper har krysset inn i deres territorium, noe som får begge sider til å appellere til FN om avskrekking eller intervensjon. Kampene spenner nå over Tigray, Amhara og grenseområdet, og Etiopia advarer Eritrea om at de vil forsvare seg etter påståtte troppeinntrengninger. Eritrea og Etiopia anklager hverandre for å provosere krig mens tigrayanske opprørere trekker seg tilbake. FN‑sjefen uttrykte dyp bekymring for fornyet kamp i Nord‑Etiopia. UCDP registrerte 2 824 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Fano insurgency
background.extract: The Fano insurgency is an armed conflict and insurgency in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia that began in April 2023 between the Fano militia and the Ethiopian government. The conflict started after the government attempted to dissolve the Amhara Special Forces and other regional forces as part of a plan to reform and centralize the country's security apparatus, and integrate them into the federal armed forces. This move led to protests and armed resistance by local forces under Fano.
